name: daylist
description: Read and edit your DayList to-do widget from Claude — main list and projects. Add tasks, priorities, reminders, recurring tasks; complete, set the current focus, and review the archive. Changes appear live in the desktop widget.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (main list or a project; filter by status/priority)

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task (main list or a project) with priority, reminder, notes

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task's fields by id or title

tools.name: view_archive
tools.description: Review archived completed tasks and notes

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project (its own task list)

tools.name: add_recurring
tools.description: Add a recurring task (daily/weekdays/weekly, optional time)
